description: The plot illustrates BLEU score as a function of a numeric x-axis variable for four methods labeled “Consistency-CE,” “Inconsistency-CE,” “Inconsistency-CE-MP,” and “Consistency-Bi.” The x-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and spans approximately from 0 to 10 with visible tick labels at 0, 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU,” uses a linear scale, and ranges roughly from 18 to 29 with major tick marks every 2 units (18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28). The “Consistency-CE” series is a light purple dashed line with circular markers, starting near BLEU ≈18.8 at x=0 and rising through about 22.9 at x≈3, 24.5 at x≈5, 26.3 at x≈7.5, and ending around 27.0 at x=10. The “Inconsistency-CE” series is a darker purple solid line with square markers, beginning around BLEU ≈20.1 at x=0 and increasing to about 22.9 at x≈3, 24.4 at x≈5, 26.3 at x≈7.5, and about 27.0 at x=10. The “Inconsistency-CE-MP” series is a blue dashed line with square markers, starting near BLEU ≈18.5 at the leftmost point (slightly before x=0), then reaching about 21.8 at x≈2, 24.6 at x≈5, 26.3 at x≈7.5, and ending near 27.1 at x=10. The “Consistency-Bi” series is a red solid line with star markers, beginning around BLEU ≈22.4 at x≈1, rising to about 26.1 at x≈3, 27.3 at x≈6, peaking near 28.7 at x≈8.5, and ending slightly lower around 28.5 at x=10.
